lines.say: Classify by tissues, symmetry, germ layers, body cavity and development.
Cnidarians are radial with two germ layers. Bilaterians have three.
Proto means first mouth. Deutero means second mouth. You're a deuterostome.

draw.alt: Blastopore becomes mouth in protostomes and anus in deuterostomes

lines.say: Survivorship: Type one die old, Type two steady, Type three die young.
Sporophyte makes spores. Gametophyte makes gametes.
Moss is mostly gametophyte. In every other group the sporophyte dominates.

draw.alt: Gametophyte shrinking and sporophyte growing from moss to flowering plants

lines.say: Angiosperms use double fertilisation. One sperm makes the zygote, one makes endosperm.
Fungi absorb their food through hyphae with chitin walls.
The cytoplasm marries first, the nuclei move in later. Plasmogamy, then karyogamy.
Negative feedback reverses a change. Positive feedback amplifies it.
In the sea, drink and pee a little. In the river, drink nothing and pee a lot.
Ammonia for aquatic, urea for us, uric acid for the unwatered.

draw.alt: Nitrogen wastes from most water needed to least

lines.say: Birds and mammals have four chambered hearts and a double circulation.
Exponential growth is a J curve, while resources are unlimited.
Logistic growth is an S curve, slowing as it nears K.
It peaks at half full, like a car park. There, the rate is r K over 4.

draw.alt: Logistic curve with fastest point at K/2

lines.say: Simpson's D is a two pick test: the chance two individuals are different species.
Primary succession starts on bare ground. Secondary starts where soil remains.
Competition is minus minus. Predation is plus minus. Mutualism is plus plus.
Fundamental niche is the dream. Realised niche is the reality.
Batesian is a bluffer. Müllerian is a mutual warning.
Proximate is how. Ultimate is why it evolved.
Hamilton's rule: relatives' benefit beats cost.
R nought is new infections from one case, when everyone is susceptible.
Herd immunity is one minus one over R nought.
Myxoma virus in Australian rabbits evolved towards intermediate virulence.
MHC rule of 8. CD4 reads class two. CD8 reads class one.

draw.alt: CD4 pairs with MHC II, CD8 pairs with MHC I

lines.say: Memory cells make the secondary response faster, larger and longer.
